text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the category version at the list level**

The recorded artifact and loader define one top-level list version, but this type definition also requires every `SweepCategory` to carry a `version` field. The planned JSON categories do not contain that field, leaving the implementer to either reject the committed artifact, synthesize an undocumented value, or weaken the declared type. Remove the per-category field or add it consistently to the artifact and validation contract.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
